title: Why not a band of young musicians like Woody Herman's
summary: Basie says younger bandleaders have exciting bands, but he wants fullness and the Basie sound; a band of young players doing their own thing would not be his style.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
